key_points: Yazoo City outage extending into H1 2027 is materially negative for CF's UAN and AN volumes and margins.
Recent cost pressures from purchased product, freight, distribution, and maintenance weaken the margin outlook despite cheaper natural gas.
Valuation remains attractive on earnings and nitrogen tailwinds, but this may not offset near-term operational disruption.
Lower price target implies limited near-term upside and reflects a more cautious earnings outlook.
The negative operational news likely outweighs longer-term structural positives over the coming weeks to months.
